components.name: Primary SQL Action
components.description: The main dossier-style action that jumps from the decision to reproducible SQL evidence.

components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; min-height: 2.9rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .015em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 1.1rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--ink-2); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Language Switch
components.description: A square two-segment mono control for the English and Traditional Chinese views.
components.css: .ds-language-switch { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); } .ds-language-switch button { min-width: 3rem; padding: .42rem .62rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--ink); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-language-switch button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-language-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; } .ds-language-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Evidence Navigation Item
components.description: A ruled evidence-index row whose active state exposes the current exhibit with safety orange.
components.html: DecisionConclusion and gate01
components.css: .ds-evidence-nav { width: 17rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--ink); color: #dfe8ec; } .ds-evidence-link { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: .65rem .7rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #294761; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-evidence-link span { font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-evidence-link small { display: block; margin-top: .18rem; color: #9db0bc; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-evidence-link b { color: #93a9b7; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-evidence-link:hover { background: #173a5b; } .ds-evidence-link.is-active { background: #1f4a73; color: #fff; } .ds-evidence-link.is-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; width: 3px; height: 2rem; background: var(--orange); } .ds-evidence-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: The flat ruled paper container that holds one auditable evidence section.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-exhibit { position: relative; padding: 3.6rem clamp(1.25rem,2.4vw,2rem) clamp(1.25rem,2.4vw,2rem); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-top-color: var(--ink); background: var(--white); color: var(--ink); } .ds-exhibit h2 { max-width: 18ch; margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(2.25rem,4vw,4rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: .98; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-exhibit p { max-width: 70ch; margin: 1rem 0 0; color: #455b69; } .ds-exhibit-tab { position: absolute; top: -1px; left: -1px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; height: 1.85rem; padding: 0 1.1rem 0 .7rem; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; clip-path: polygon(0 0,calc(100% - .55rem) 0,100% 100%,0 100%); font-family: var(--display); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-exhibit-tab span + span { color: #c7d4da; }

components.name: Exhibit Tab
components.description: The clipped navy index tab that fixes an exhibit number and subject to the paper edge.

narrative.overview:
This system makes an operating decision feel earned. Cool-gray dossier paper, deep navy ink, square exhibit tabs, and fine rules organize the page like a reviewed case file; verification green confirms evidence, while safety orange marks breaches, quarantine, overspend, and the final hold decision.

The visual density is analytical rather than decorative. Condensed headlines deliver conclusions, mono labels identify measurements and procedural evidence, and the workhorse sans keeps explanations readable in English and Traditional Chinese. The system explicitly rejects the generic portfolio dashboard: evidence remains sequential, traceable, and visibly tied to the decision.
keyCharacteristics: Three-part dossier shell with a persistent evidence index, central case file, and decision rail.
Flat paper surfaces separated by fine rules rather than floating dashboard cards.
Square controls and clipped exhibit tabs with restrained industrial geometry.
Verification green and safety orange used only to communicate evidence state.
Responsive evidence navigation, reduced-motion support, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Evidence-State Rule
rules.body: Green means verified or passing; orange means breach, quarantine, cost, or stop. Never use either as decoration.

rules.name: The Navy Authority Rule
rules.body: Deep navy owns structure and primary action; it is not a generic accent sprayed across data.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for code, counts, dates, thresholds, and evidence metadata; it does not replace body copy.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: Condensed type states the conclusion before the body face explains it.

rules.name: The Evidence-Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive changes may reflow evidence but must not reorder the path from decision to cleaning, experiment, guardrails, budget, SQL, and artifacts.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence rests on paper and rules; it does not float in a stack of generic cards.

rules.name: The Square Dossier Rule
rules.body: Preserve hard corners and fine borders; rounded pills and soft dashboard cards contradict the case-file form.

dos: Do lead with the operating decision, then keep every visual claim traceable through the evidence sequence.
Do reserve verification green for passed or trusted evidence and safety orange for risk or stop states.
Do keep exhibits flat, square, ruled, and visibly part of one dossier.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, bilingual type fallbacks, and the mobile evidence order.
donts: Don't turn the case study into a generic portfolio dashboard of rounded, floating cards.
Don't use green or orange as decorative brand color without evidence-state meaning.
Don't add pill controls, soft gradients, decorative texture, or unsupported input and dialog patterns.
Don't hide the synthetic-data disclosure or separate a conclusion from its underlying repository evidence.
